judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A moody overcast sky with a pleasant warm glow at the horizon, but too flat and unstructured to be more than a decent snapshot.
strengths: warm peach glow along the lower edge
nice contrast between heavy dark mass and bright horizon
weaknesses: upper two-thirds is flat and featureless
little distinct cloud structure or texture
no strong focal point or composition
